---
title: "analysis sample composition"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(here)
library(pctax)
library(pcutils)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
# read in tax file
path <- '~/project_data/downy/result/asm-fcs-kraken2/oomycota-genomic/0.5/'
df <- list.files(path, pattern = '.fcs_gx_report.txt', full.names = T) %>% 
  map_dfr(function(x) {
    fread(x) %>% 
      mutate(sample = str_remove(basename(x), '.fcs_gx_report.txt'))
  })

```


```{r,message=FALSE}
otu <- df %>% 
  group_by(sample,top_tax_name) %>% 
  summarise(count = n()) %>% 
  arrange(desc(count)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  column_to_rownames('top_tax_name')

tax <- name_or_id2df(rownames(otu), mode = 'name', add_prefix = FALSE) %>% 
  select(-taxid) %>% 
  column_to_rownames('name')
  
```

```{r}
otu.prop <- trans(otu, method = 'total')
phylum <- hebing(otu.prop, tax$Phylum, margin = 1, act = "sum")
stackplot(phylum)
```
```{r}
otu.prop %>% 
  mutate(mean = rowMeans(.)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(mean)) %>% 
  select(-mean) %>%
  head(30) %>% 
  gt(rownames_to_stub = TRUE) %>%
  fmt_percent()
```
